title: Dragonwilds Imaru Guide | Boss Mechanics, Gear & Strategies
author: Thurnax
description:
Struggling to defeat Imaru?

In this complete Dragonwilds boss guide, I'll walk you through everything you need to know to consistently defeat Imaru using melee, ranged, or magic.

We'll cover the recommended loadouts for each combat style, break down Imaru's mechanics phase by phase, explain how to survive the spectral phase, and highlight the mistakes that cause most players to fail the encounter.

📌 In this guide:
Best melee setup 02:30
Best ranged setup 08:39
Best magic setup 21:31
Imaru mechanics explained
Spectral phase walkthrough
Positioning & movement
Attack pattern breakdown
Food & consumables
Tips for consistent kills

This is part of my Dragonwilds Boss Guide Series, with guides for Velgar, Black Knight Titan, Fuzan, and future bosses on the way.

Looking for other Dragonwilds players? Join the Thurnax Enclave Discord community to share builds, ask questions, and team up with the community.

If this guide helped you, consider leaving a like and subscribing for more Dragonwilds progression guides, boss guides, and endgame content.

— Thurnax
